headline: SOL 7 EVENING DISPATCH: The Magnetohydrodynamic Shear
anchor_intro: [VEX]: Good evening Enclave! [DORIAN]: Another sol, another dispatch.

lead_story.story_title: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
lead_story.narrative_summary: Ryn braced against the roaring heat of The Hearth as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea triggered massive pressure spikes in the galley. She moved quickly to DEFEND the sensitive copper piping from exploding under the strain. Hoping to draw off the excess energy, she worked to ATTRACT the magnetic discharge into the main grounding coils. As the storm peaked, she threw the pressure valves wide open to CONSUME the dangerous buildup, safely stabilizing the system. Without missing a beat, Ryn confidently passed the telemetry baton to Silas.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Hearth is a sprawling, steam-filled galley where industrial pipes double as spice racks and heat radiators. Copper kettles bubble over specialized induction burners that hum with immense contained energy.

sensory_palette.smell: A hearty mix of braised mire-lentils and roasted tubers.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A comforting, humid warmth that quickly cuts through the chill of the storm.
